title: MemoryCard
description: Evidence-backed memory item Hermes extracts from a meeting. Phase-3 redesign collapsed the user-curation state machine: there is no `state` enum and no `needs_review`. Quality is owned by the agent audit + consolidation passes via `confidence`, `hidden_at`, and `superseded_by_id`. Source of truth: design-doc §13.

speakers_json.description: List of speaker names/ids implicated by this card; mirrors speaker_segments rows.

hidden_at.description: Agent-driven soft delete; list endpoints filter `hidden_at IS NULL` by default.

superseded_by_id.description: If set, points at the canonical winner card from the agent consolidation pass.

audit_reason.description: Free-text rationale set by the agent audit pass when it downgrades or hides a card.
